subject.description: The dev.knotless.pull, dev.knotless.issue or dev.knotless.comment to leave out.

main.description: Kept in the owner's account, keyed by a TID, one per hidden record; for a private repository, in their repo inside its space. Readers honor it only from the owner. Comments and state changes on a hidden pull or issue go with it. Accounts the owner blocks (dev.knotless.block) are left out as well, without one.

description: A pull, issue or comment a repository's owner hides, as app.bsky.feed.postgate detaches quotes of a post.
